evidence_requirement: two mechanically independent signals per load-bearing claim (rules/common/single-signal-verification.md); every claim carries source lineage (resolved URL + fetch timestamp + sha256 of the fetched bytes), a Sherman-Kent confidence band, and a named independent verification path (_USER-PROMPTS.md:10717); each elicited estimate is recorded with its calibration-question score so an uncalibrated participant's number is visibly discounted; elicited values are never promoted to measured values
inputs: _USER-PROMPTS.md:10681-10717 (Phase 2 source classes, 12 research modes, claim requirements)
question_or_target: Specify a structured elicitation protocol (reference-class framing, independent priors, calibration questions, aggregation) for questions where no literature exists, and determine on 6 such questions whether elicited estimates add information over an honest NOT-FOUND. Distinct from the council bucket: this is a research-input mode, not a decision protocol.
retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: after 2 failures on the same error fingerprint, enumerate >=2 alternative approaches before a third attempt (AGENTS.md 4b)
reviewer_requirement: one independent adversarial refuter in a fresh context who defaults to REFUTED when evidence is insufficient (spec:11062)
tests_required: negative control: include 2 questions that DO have a literature answer, elicit blind, and compare - if elicitation misses a known answer the mode is reported as weak rather than adopted
title: Structured expert elicitation: can it be run with agent participants, and does it beat a search?
